init.title: Event Vision Settings
init.description:
Saved settings: model {model_name}, {max_frames} frames per event ({sampling_policy}), fusion {fusion_state}, minimum job deadline {min_deadline}s.

Save applies all settings on this page. Leave the API key blank to keep the saved key.

data.gemini_api_key: Gemini API Key (leave blank to keep saved key)

data_description.gemini_api_key: The saved key is never shown. Leave blank to keep it.
data_description.prompt_instructions: Additional guidance appended to the base analysis prompt. Maximum 1000 characters.
data_description.max_frames: Maximum frames extracted per event. Increasing this requires a longer job deadline.

data_description.enable_fusion: Off by default. Enabling issues additional Gemini requests and incurs extra cost. Fusion results are uncertain hypotheses, not identity proofs.
data_description.fusion_job_deadline: Must fit the fusion frame budget, provider timeout, and extraction timeout.

data.frame_cache_mb: Extracted Frame Cache Budget (MB, 0 to disable)

data_description.job_deadline: Must fit the frame budget, extraction timeout, and provider timeout.
